correctness.rationale: PASS: At stationary two-sided Mallows t=Q^-1 (0<t<1), D=R-L, P(R=r)=(1-t)t^r, conditional E[z^L|R=r]=prod_{k=r+1}∞(1-t^k)/(1-zt^k). At z=-1 obtain absolutely convergent signed geometric series. Factoring (t;t)_∞/(-t;t)_∞ and applying q-binomial with a=z=-t yields Δ=E[(-1)^D]=((t;t)_∞/(-t;t)_∞)^2. Infinite products converge strictly positive for each t<1; each factor decreases strictly, giving desired sign, Q monotonicity and endpoint limits. The published identification of c_o,c_e with even/odd displacement probability supplies interpretation. Independently summed conditional law and product for t=.05,.12,.25,.42,.6,.8, agreement at displayed precision; finite results are corroboration, not a proof.
